title: Morocco Leads Africa in Millionaire Growth — 400 Ultra-Rich Individuals in 2026
body:
Morocco recorded Africa's fastest growth in high-net-worth individuals — 12% year-on-year — crossing the 400 ultra-wealthy threshold in 2026, ahead of Egypt, Nigeria and South Africa, per the AfrAsia Bank Africa Wealth Report.

Marrakech's Role

Marrakech accounts for 35% of luxury property transactions by Moroccan buyers. The Palmeraie, Hivernage and Agdal districts receive the most domestic ultra-HNW investment. The World Cup infrastructure cycle has created additional wealth in construction, hospitality and logistics.

Source: AfrAsia Bank Africa Wealth Report 2026, via AlphaBourse.
